newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Wyndham Hotel started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Wyndham Hotel started.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said Monday it initiated coverage of Wyndham Hotel Corp with a buy rating due to rapid earnings per share growth and improving fundamentals in the upper end of the lodging segment.

-- It said the upscale segment of the lodging industry will continue to post increases in occupancy and average daily rates. It said Wyndham will benefit from "positive" supply and demand relationship in the upper end of the lodging market.
-- Salomon said it expects Wyndham to earn $0.85 a share in 1997 and $1.10 a share in 1998.
